assertion_analysis.tests/test_crew_census.py:159,160,161,16: Fail on negative age, invalid running state, lost wait-channel read or wrong cwd; metadata validity checks do not independently establish exact age or wait-channel accuracy.

assertion_analysis.tests/test_crew_census.py:179,181,182,18: Fail on CLI refusal, missing/wrong/extra target output, no successful stop, wrong actual signal, or killing either live-owner or argv-only control; OS returncode and poll provide independent effects.
assertion_analysis.tests/test_crew_census.py:194,195,196: Fail if dry-run refuses, omits its planted orphan or sends a signal; child poll is independent of report data.
assertion_analysis.tests/test_crew_census.py:203,208,209: Fail if expired producer is not initially listed or apply ignores renewed lease and kills it; renewal changes the authoritative record after report capture.
assertion_analysis.tests/test_crew_census.py:231,232: Fail if foreign/reused/incomplete producer registrations authorize selection or lose the spared explanation; remove each verification branch to make its parameter case red.
assertion_analysis.tests/test_crew_census.py:245: Fails if the supported follower-owner environment stamp is ignored; fixture supplies owner encoding and independent child pid.

assertion_analysis.tests/test_crew_census.py:262,263,265: Fail if run-pointer ownership cannot select/stop its child or apply rewrites/deletes the pointer; before bytes are a preserved independent file snapshot, not an echoed result.
assertion_analysis.tests/test_crew_census.py:274,278,279: Fail if escalation is omitted, signals/target differ, actual SIGKILL does not occur, or re-scanning adds a later orphan to the original stop set.
assertion_analysis.tests/test_crew_census.py:287,288,295,29: Fail if live followers are selected, duplicate reporting is lost/wrong, empty apply gains targets, or either live follower is stopped.
assertion_analysis.tests/test_crew_census.py:310,311: Fail if malformed or foreign ownership is treated as proof of death instead of spared unknown.

assertion_analysis.tests/test_crew_census.py:354,355,359,36: Fail if matching contradictory registrations select a process, omit the ambiguity reason, allow apply targets or kill the process.
